title: Eddie Hickman's band, a battle of bands and Octave Frost
summary: Vincent and Punch Miller recall Eddie Hickman's band and its sidemen, including George McCullum, Max Williams and Lawrence Coleman, and a contest between two bands. They then try to place pianist Octave Frost.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
